name: smwmusic-lagrange-point-the-resurrection-of-sabbath
title: Lagrange Point - The Resurrection of Sabbath
description:
The staff roll song.

There's two soundfonts included inside the port, one that was extracted from the NSF files, and Famitracker, and other from the ROM through an emulator. To choose between the two, change the "ROM_Soundfont" define to 0 to use the NSF soundfont, and vice-versa.
